item.tib: bder gshegs dpa' bo bdun sgrub kyi phyag bzhes me long bdun bskor gyi rtsa ba gser gyi me long
item.coloph: ces pas bder gshegs dpa' bo bdun sgrub gcod tshul yan lag dang bcas pa lag tu blang ba'i me long bdun skor gyi rtsa ba gser gyi me long 'di/ mchog spral sangs rgyas gling pa'i mched chung pad+ma blo ldan gyi bka' dang / phyag mdzod tsha ba rong pa g.yung drung 'od zer gyis nan du bsgrab zhing*/ stag gu gcod pa rnam rgyal/ 'brog lhun grub sogs grogs po rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba'i phyir/ me 'brug gi zla ba dang por snyoms las pa gsang sngags grags pa'i(pas) dge sbyor thun mtshams su ngag nas smon bzhin/ drung yig shes rab tshul khrims kyis shog thog tu gang zin myur du bris pa yin pas/ rjes 'jug gis zhib par spyod la/ ma dag pa snang tshe 'phos par gnang zhing / legasa'abyung bstan 'gro phan phyir sems bskyed pa ci bzhin 'grub pa'i smon pa dang bcas/ dga' ba pad lung gnas kyi dbus mar dga' ldan dpal gyi ri bo che'i dbang thog g.yung drung bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gdan sa bkra shis smin grol khrod kyi bla brang sgrub khang yang rtser bris so//
